mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, current conditions at City Hall show 46 degrees with clear skies. The moon is currently in its first quarter phase.

In city news, the Verona Police Department successfully arrested a school bus driver on Thursday following reports of dangerous driving. Additionally, the City of Verona has updated polling information, reminding residents to check their designated locations before the next election.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company throughout the day. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for yoga on October 19 and various trivia nights starting October 20.

Regarding the recent arrest on Thursday, the Verona Police Department apprehended a school bus driver near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace for O W I. Authorities confirmed that while alcohol was not the cause, the investigation into potential property damage is ongoing.
If you are craving something sweet, stop by Culver's to try the Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and serving customers until their closing time of 10:30 PM.
